subject: frostAxe
pitch:
Category: Fantasy weapon.
Subject: frost-forged battle axe.
Style: League of Legends.
reasoning:
The axe head's size appears disproportionately small compared to the haft and base, contrasting with League of Legends' stylized, exaggerated weapon proportions. The goal is to make the axe head significantly larger, wider, and more substantial with thicker bevels. The "frost-forged" aesthetic will be applied to the more heroic and chunky stylized axe.


The current socket cage presents as a blocky cube with awkwardly intersecting ram horns; this needs to be redesigned with majestic, chunky horns that cup the central chamber. The blade lacks depth, facet detail, and the icy gradients seen in League of Legends True Ice; the current rune placement and size are also problematic. The back hook appears flimsy, and the wolf fur ruff's flat, downward-pointing cards need reworking to layered, volumetric clumps. The base crystals should be faceted clusters.


The upright axe presents a static pose; a dynamic tilt or head-embedded position would enhance visual storytelling. Proportion analysis reveals the axe head's current size at only 19% of the model's height, significantly undercutting its heroic potential and LoL inspiration. Scaling the axe head to at least 0.7-0.9m height and 0.8-1.1m width will amplify its champion-weapon presence, supported by a chunky haft with grip rings and reinforced bands. The 'Glacial Heart' housing requires a Freljordian iron framework and a runic display window.


The primary blade will be significantly enlarged and reshaped into a sweeping True Ice crescent, incorporating layered metal plates and prominent Freljordian runes. The back pick requires expansion into a formidable armor-breaker with multiple crystalline facets and spine spikes. The top spearhead will be enlarged to establish a regal Freljordian silhouette. The cage will be replaced with an octagonal/beveled runic chamber and the horns thickened and braided. The Glacial Heart crystal will be enlarged and multi-faceted.


The socket cage will be redesigned with curved, crest-like elements, inspired by Ornn/Braum, incorporating glowing runic frost channels. Blade runes require adjustment for optimal visibility; True Ice shading will be enhanced with multi-tone coloring and faceted details. Brackets will be redesigned with brass/gold forged jaws and frost runes.

The fur ruff will be built with layered volumetric clumps, with stylized fur cards and braided gold torcs with dangling talismans. The haft necessitates a taper, leather wraps, glowing rune bands, and an ornate pommel. Crystal clusters will be replaced with chunky, hexagonal, faceted angular clusters for the altar setting.


```ts
The stone altar requires structural redesign, introducing leaning pentagonal columns emanating from frost fissures, enhancing the environment's dynamic feel. Implementing radial frost cracks on the altar surface with snow drifts and glowing runic carvings will add visual detail. Ethereal frost mist and sparkle cards will be placed around the base and blade to build a desired atmosphere.
```

Altar dimensions indicate a need for a deeply cracked, frosty base with angular ice crystals. Shaft components require detailed leather wrapping, glowing rune channels within an octagonal steel casing, and a volumetric fur collar with braided gold accents. The axe socket presents a heavy forged iron octagon with prominent ram horns; its aperture must showcase the 'Glacial Heart' crystal. The blade's span and height values establish an appropriate scale for heroic presentation.


A layered construction of the axe head is planned, starting with a dark steel chassis and adding glowing runic plates. The True Ice blade will be massive with beveled edges, a high horn, and low hook. Golden jaws and heavy bolts will lock the ice blade, while jagged icicles hang from its beard.

The secondary blade will be a True Ice armor-piercing pick with a steel hammer-poll and brass plates. A diamond-profile spearhead will be mounted atop.

Various textures are planned, including Freljordian runes, a ram/wolf crest, fur tufts, sparkles, and leather, to achieve a visually rich design.
